subject: design/config-driven-portability-v1
statement: The engine's non-Go surfaces receive config-driven values by **two mechanisms chosen per constraint, not one uniform one** (`design-brainstorm:config-driven-portability-tech-design#D-1` · `#ALT-2`). The installed CI workflow becomes a **generated**-class file that converge renders from the repo config — its trigger is a static literal the CI host evaluates without computation, so it must be materialized at converge, re-rendered when config changes. The git-hooks stay **engine-verbatim** (byte-identical in every repository) and drop their branch/remote literals: they invoke `pyxis` for the checks they already delegate, and `pyxis` (Go, reads config) resolves branch and remote at runtime. Config is the single source for both surfaces — neither carries a hand-maintained second list (AP-11; this is the failure `docs/observability/incidents.md#I5` records). The Go-side resolution extends the existing config-struct read (new closed-schema keys read directly, no new port), and cross-field validation folds into config load. A reader who stops here knows the shape: **one config, resolved live by Go, rendered at converge for the one surface that cannot resolve live.**
